title: Grateful Dead Live at Felt Forum - Madison Square Garden on 1971-12-05

ai_review.summary: Stellar soundboard capture of the Dec 5 1971 Felt Forum show, with smoking renditions of Jack Straw, Brown Eyed Women, El Paso and a memorable Dark Star jam.
ai_review.review: This recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that lets listeners hear the energy of the famed New York concert. The performance is highlighted by flawless first‑set classics like Jack Straw, Tennessee Jed, Brown Eyed Women and an explosive El Paso, plus a satisfying Dark Star jam in the second set. Reviewers repeatedly note the vivid mix and the high‑octane crowd that makes this show one of the era’s favorites.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are five‑star, praising both the musical performance and the pristine recording; the consensus is overwhelmingly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with superb balance; reviewers call it top‑quality, no significant dropouts or muffling mentioned.

standout_songs: Going Down the Road (China Cat tease)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First‑set classics are delivered with tight, inspired playing; second set is shorter but includes a notable Dark Star jam and maintains strong momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for incredible phrasing and tone throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Billy (Weir) “goes balls out” on El Paso, delivering a standout performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's presence noted as special; keyboards add to the overall vibe.
